data.name: RootDescription
data.value: Joins overlapping flatbed scans of one side of a box into a single image.

data.name: ScansArgumentDescription
data.value: Scans to join, in any order.

data.name: OutputOptionDescription
data.value: Output image; the format follows the extension (.png, .tif, .jpg…).

data.name: DetectorOptionDescription
data.value: Feature detector used to find common points.

data.name: SeamOptionDescription
data.value: How overlaps are resolved: an optimal hard cut, or later scans overwriting earlier ones.

data.name: ColorOptionDescription
data.value: Equalize scan colors with a per-channel gain and offset, or leave them untouched.

data.name: BackgroundOptionDescription
data.value: Fill for areas not covered by any scan.

data.name: MaxDimensionOptionDescription
data.value: Longest side, in pixels, that scans are reduced to for feature detection.

data.name: MinInliersOptionDescription
data.value: Minimum matching points for two scans to be considered overlapping.

data.name: DebugOptionDescription
data.value: Directory to write match and seam diagnostic images to.
